caption: The drawing depicts a single ornate ceramic pot or bowl set upon a matching tray, both of which have ruffled, undulating edges. The pot features a scalloped rim and a rounded body, decorated with swirls and floral or leaf-like patterns. The primary colors are earthy greens, reddish-browns, ochres, and hints of pink and blue, blending together in a painterly style. The matching tray beneath has a similar ruffled pattern and a predominantly brownish-red hue, with traces of darker tones. There is some faint, decorative script partially visible on the body of the pot. The background is plain, off-white, and unadorned. The artist's signature, "M.L. Armstrong," is visible to the right of the objects near the bottom.
title: Pa. German Flower Pot and Tray
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
